name: greater-components
description: Fediverse UI components built with Svelte 5, TypeScript, and pnpm workspaces
author: Equal To AI

scripts.build: pnpm -r build && node scripts/assert-face-runes-compiled.mjs && pnpm format:types
scripts.generate: pnpm generate:graphql && pnpm generate:openapi && pnpm generate:openapi:lesser-host
scripts.sveltekit:sync: pnpm --filter @equaltoai/playground exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm --filter @greater-components/docs exec svelte-kit sync
scripts.check:svelte: pnpm --dir packages/primitives exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/icons exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/utils exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/content exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/shell exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/host-platform exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/shared/admin exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/shared/auth exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/shared/compose exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/shared/messaging exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/shared/notifications exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/shared/search exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/shared/soul exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/shared/chat exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/shared/agent exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/faces/social exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/faces/artist exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/faces/blog exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/faces/community exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --dir packages/faces/agent exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.check.json
scripts.test:coverage:report: COVERAGE_LINES=75 COVERAGE_FUNCTIONS=75 COVERAGE_STATEMENTS=75 COVERAGE_BRANCHES=60 node scripts/aggregate-coverage.js
scripts.smoke:agent-face: pnpm --filter @equaltoai/greater-components-agent-face... build && pnpm build:agent-face-example && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p examples/agent-face-svelte/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @equaltoai/playground build && pnpm --filter @equaltoai/greater-components exec vitest run tests/agent-face.smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:facetheory: pnpm build:facetheory-example && pnpm --filter @equaltoai/greater-components-primitives exec vitest run tests/facetheory.integration.test.ts && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p examples/facetheory-svelte/tsconfig.json
scripts.validate:package: pnpm validate:exports && pnpm validate:dist && pnpm validate:deps && pnpm validate:cli && pnpm validate:check-parity && pnpm validate:tokens && pnpm validate:ids && pnpm validate:csp && pnpm validate:versions && pnpm check:openapi-auth && pnpm check:adapter-declarations && pnpm check:contract-snapshots
scripts.validate:registry: node scripts/validate-registry-index.js --strict && node scripts/generate-registry-index.js --check && pnpm validate:versions
scripts.typecheck: NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=16384' pnpm run sveltekit:sync && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=16384' tsc --noEmit
